_readme: Edit this file to change contact details, booking and pricing on the website without rebuilding. Leave a value empty ("") to hide it. Never put passwords or API keys here — this file is public.

setupIncludes: Your branch details, hours, delivery rules and products set up
Lee (or Aman in Punjabi) configured for your branch
Test calls with your team before go-live
Help adding the call forward on your phone system
weeklyIncludes: Your receptionist answering the calls you forward
Every call written up in your dashboard, urgent ones flagged
Knowledge, staff and routing kept up to date as things change
pricing.usageNote: Telephone and AI usage are agreed with you up front, based on your call volumes, and confirmed in your quote.
